hypotheses: The equal-share axle allocator discards same-side realizable transfers. Reconstruct all 18 first torques to 1e-9 Nm from the archive, then change only the split. Report both sign-to-sign and each sign-to-zero differences, conserved side totals and ideal roll moment. Six terrain/seed records have only three distinct pre-contact states.

Legacy longitudinal force saturates almost every tick. Change only scalar LQR R from 1e-8 to 1/(180 N)^2, charging unit input cost at the original force bound. Q, identified model, plant, torque limits, heading, commands, noise, 20 ms estimator delay, 82-degree first return at 6 Hz/40 ms, and 0.40 m window remain round 85. Development reference is the archived legacy zero-residual trajectory for each paired terrain/seed.

If the normalized-R development arm fails, replace only the 12 leg damping velocity inputs on that arm with a causal 20-ms predictor trained on round-85 development transitions. Offline labels are current encoders, features use only two-tick-old leg angles/velocities and the two intervening applied torque vectors. Fit a separate linear ridge per leg on standardized inputs, unpenalized intercept, penalty 0.01 in mean-square loss units, and clip estimates to training velocity extrema. Deduplicate identical transitions and split by whole seed 8561/8573/8587. Require >=10% improvement in pooled 12-leg-axis RMSE versus delayed velocity in each of three held-out folds before fitting the final predictor and running the second arm. No training on 86 fresh routes and no sweep.

A single PPO step should produce a finite, nonzero change to the Gaussian mean policy for each of three RNG seeds and reload the same deterministic outputs. Exercise the updater separately on a synthetic fixture. Actual on-policy D1 samples are allowed only if every preregistered physical gate passes.

development.selection: First arm in registered order that satisfies all original checks. If the first passes, skip the fallback. No selection by return or a single seed.

zero_case_checks: Require six full six-second routes, no falls or torque-limit violations, loaded front contact and front axle passage at toe+0.40 m, and one same fresh 82-degree packet correctly signed at >=0.5 deg on three consecutive precontact ticks. Also reconcile first qualifying window with the actual four ground endpoints, and report all precontact wrong packets. Eligibility of the fallback or of improved force headroom alone is insufficient.

pulse_qualification.rule: Use the selected zero-action baseline plus the same-side allocator. Reuse round-85 first loaded precontact checkpoint, negative/zero/positive branches, torque-separation, actual load, common entry pitch RMSE >=0.01 degree, no falls/violations and total support/unchanged wheel checks in full. Report separately whether both signs produce nonzero transfer. No retries for missed triggers.

ppo_smoke.model: CPU float64 independent linear Gaussian mean and scalar critic. All weights/bias initially zero, fixed normal std 0.25. Sample raw actions from that policy; clip to [-1,1] for transfer +/-0.02mg while scoring log likelihood on the raw sample.
ppo_smoke.obs: Nine causal values: measured roll and pitch /0.4, roll/pitch body rate /5, measured forward velocity and commanded speed /0.35, 82-degree valid grade /12deg (zero if unavailable), validity flag and frame age /0.25 (one if missing). Clip each feature to [-5,5]. No simulator geometry identity, truth pitch, contact event, terrain name, or seed in policy inputs.
ppo_smoke.reward: Each actual post-step delayed estimate is scored against the pre-action measured target: pitch reference=identified operating pitch plus negative observed grade if valid, else estimated support pitch. Per tick r=-(pitch error/0.10)^2-0.25*((measured forward speed-command)/0.35)^2-0.01*mean((applied torque/per-axis limit)^2)-10*fall. Physical truth remains for safety/scoring only. Same formula reserved for future world-model comparison.
ppo_smoke.checks: Two 64-tick segments, same seed and recorded boundaries, bootstrap truncated endpoints with their next observation without crossing the reset in GAE. Refuse nonfinite inputs, reward, losses, weights, any early termination/short segment. Require a nonzero mean-head and finite nonzero actor gradient, and exact fixed-input reload. Record commanded/applied actions. No checkpoint promotion or performance ranking under this budget. Failed/partial runs are not resumed.
ppo_smoke.fixture: Three seeds, 2 x 64 transitions per seed, same optimizer and reload path on a deterministic synthetic actuator fixture. Fixture updates are excluded from D1 physics and training totals.

supervision: Each heavy stage is serial, CPU single-environment, single-core and single-thread, Nice 10, MemoryHigh 2GiB, MemoryMax 3GiB, swap 0, startup effective available >=4GiB and retained >=2GiB. Exclusive new artifacts; retain all failed and partial outputs. No resumption, archived budget-48 rerun or runtime rebinding.
